edits.old:
When a request to each provided operation carries no credential, carries no role, or names an unknown case
    Then the answer to the request with no credential is 401
    Then the answer to the request with no role is 403
    Then the answer to the request with an unknown case is 404
edits.new:
When a request carries no session, comes from a role without the Platform administration right, or is a resend that names an unknown delivery
    Then the answer to the request with no session is 401
    Then the answer to the request from a role without the Platform administration right is 403
    Then the answer to the resend that names an unknown delivery is 404

edits.old: | Contract | Each provided operation with no credential answers 401, with no role answers 403, and with an unknown case answers 404 |
edits.new: | Contract | Each provided operation with no session answers 401 and with a role without the Platform administration right answers 403; a resend that names an unknown delivery answers 404 |

edits.old: Then a delivery in EXCEPTION is resent to PENDING with attempt count 0, and a delivery not in EXCEPTION answers 409
edits.new: Then a resend of a delivery in EXCEPTION sets it to PENDING with attempt count 0, and a resend of a delivery not in EXCEPTION answers 409

edits.old: | Contract dependencies | rwb-source-data ledger append operation (BR3); rwb-case order of the timeline (REQ-ILG-006) |
edits.new: | Contract dependencies | rwb-source-data ledger append operation (BR3); the P1 EFS and contact reads; the rwb-case, rwb-comms, rwb-partner, rwb-treatment and rwb-payment fact contracts; rwb-case order of the timeline (REQ-ILG-006) |

edits.new: The texts of the legacy story are copied unchanged; this contract defines no new message and no new wording, and the rows for 401, 404 and 503 reuse existing message IDs.

The HTTP answers 401 (no session), 404 (unknown delivery) and 503 (dependency unavailable) carry no message ID in the source documents; those IDs are Not specified in the source documents (DOR-RWB-P2-E2034-CON-17).
edits.new: The exception queue screen SCR-09 is not contracted here. Its empty, error and no access states are Not specified in the source documents (DOR-RWB-P2-E2034-CON-10), and its loading state is as stated in section 15.

findings.issue: AC7 and TC-18 use 'unknown case' and 'no role'. The story's errors are no session (401), no Platform administration right (403) and unknown delivery on resend (404).
Section 14 says 401, 404 and 503 have no message ID, contradicting 12.1 and the new MSG-P4-001, MSG-P4-003 and MSG-GEN-006 rows.
Contract dependencies omit the P1 EFS and contact reads and the fact contracts that the story says it calls.
Section 14 says the SCR-09 loading state is Not specified, but section 15 takes it from Screen Specifications v1.
Section 14 still says the contract adds no message and no wording, although three message rows were added.
Actor changed to 'solution architect'. Neither this item nor the story supports it; it is only the owner role of other items.
AC3 'a delivery in EXCEPTION is resent' reads as an automatic resend; the story means a resend action sets it to PENDING.
